claim().notice: Claims vested NET (5-day linear vest from finalize).

finalize().notice: Atomic protocol switch-on (specs/genesis.md §2): splits         proceeds 70/30 treasury/POL, mints + seeds the canonical v2         pool, enables staking + bonds + trading tax, starts the pTEAM         vest clock. Callable by anyone once cap is hit (or deadline         passed with ≥ min raise).

finalizeTime().notice: Timestamp of finalize(); the single vest/tax-decay clock origin.

purchase(uint256).notice: Buys NET at GENESIS_PRICE with USDG (raw token units).         Reverts past the wallet cap, the hard cap, or the deadline.

purchasedNetOf(address).notice: NET purchased by `account` (total, vesting from finalize).

refund().notice: Refunds the caller's full purchase if the sale failed         (deadline passed below min raise — OPEN_QUESTIONS Q2).

wire(address,address).notice: One-time wiring (BondDepository ↔ GenesisBond deploy cycle;         the certificate needs this contract's address at construction).
